boundary: Manual snapshots only: no source-system fetch or business-data write. Review notifications follow existing subscriptions.
inputRules: Up to 1 MB; up to 1,000 source and 1,000 target records. Use strings for decimals and timestamps with offsets. Credentials are forbidden. The business timezone does not follow the display language.
invalidInput: Check JSON structure, month, timezone, field names and decimal strings. No request was sent.
createError: Creation failed or is unconfirmed. Check the input and request ID; the same ID cannot overwrite different content.
duplicate: Original preview returned; no duplicate created.
created: Preview saved. No business data was written.
importedSnapshot: Source and target values are imported declarations, not verified live snapshots.
noWrites: This stage only records review. It cannot write business data, even after approval.
write_adapter_not_implemented: Write adapter contract is not implemented.
approval_not_approved: The bound review is not approved.
approval_binding_changed: Approval contents changed or no longer match this preview.
approver_authority_unavailable: The approver no longer has the required active administrator role.
sessionRequired: Sign in as a company owner or administrator to request review.
reviewConfirm: I reviewed all displayed differences for this hash. I request review only, not execution.
reviewError: Review request failed or is unconfirmed. Refresh or retry the same preview; it will not create a second approval.
readError: Cannot read the preview or review state. Check administrator access and retry.
